# A loop over a const iterable is unrolled for a target with no host language,
# and unrolling an empty one is the else case: no iteration ran.
#
# The expansion used to be the iterations alone, so a loop that produced none
# was replaced by nothing and the else went with it -- the one case the else
# exists for. passForElse cannot cover this: the optimizer runs first, and by
# the time the pass looks there is no loop left to state an else about.

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=web app.sngl
grep '<span>nothing here</span>' web/index.html
! grep '<span>item' web/index.html

# A loop that does produce iterations is unchanged, and its else does not leak
# into the output beside them.
sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=two two.sngl
grep '<span>item 1</span>' two/index.html
grep '<span>item 2</span>' two/index.html
! grep 'nothing here' two/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const empty list<int> = []

component main {
    vbox {
        for var x = empty {
            text(value="item {x}")
        } else {
            text(value="nothing here")
        }
    }
}

-- two.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const two list<int> = [1, 2]

component main {
    vbox {
        for var x = two {
            text(value="item {x}")
        } else {
            text(value="nothing here")
        }
    }
}
